name: Shooting Victims (2006-Present)
description:
This dataset contains records of shooting victims from 2006 onward, with each row representing one victim linked to a shooting incident through a shared incident key. Six columns capture the incident identifier, a unique victim identifier, and demographic details including age group (under 18, 18-24, 25-44, 45-64, and 65+), sex, and race. A final flag indicates whether the incident was classified as a murder. The sample is predominantly male (about 91%) and majority Black (about 73%), with most victims in the 18-24 and 25-44 age groups, and roughly 18% of records flagged as murders.

The data can support analyses of shooting trends over time, demographic patterns among victims, and the proportion of shootings that result in homicide.
